title: Empire Invoke WMI (SDWIN-200921001437) — Contract A phát triển v2

ttps.behavior_description: Thực thi mã từ xa qua WMI, dùng lớp Win32_Process và phương thức Create

source_span.text: This dataset represents an adversary remotely executing code via WMI. This dataset focuses on the use of the WMI Win32_Process class and method Create to execute code remotely.
